description.narrative:
The Project is expected to have the following development impact:
Stakeholder effects increased access to climate finance: Through this investment, the Project is expected to support the Bank in increasing its climate lending portfolio, which may contribute to Jordans GHG emissions avoidance or reduction at the level of the financed activities.
Contribution to Market Creation: Sustainability: The Project is expected to contribute to the development of sustainability related capital market instruments, which may encourage replication by other issuers and mobilizing resources for climate projects. Furthermore, it is expected to raise awareness among private sector companies about the benefits of green financing, with the potential to facilitate further capital market investment for green and blue projects.

The proposed transaction involves a total bond issuance of US$120 million by Jordan Kuwait Bank PLC (JKB or the Bank), comprising an IFC subscription of up to US$100 million and an additional up to US$20 million from a co-investor. The Bank will issue a six-year, senior, unsecured green bond through a private placement (the Bond or the Project). This will be JKBs second Green Bond issuance, aligned with the International Capital Market Associations (ICMA) Green Bond Principles. The use of proceeds will follow the Banks Green Finance Framework, published in 2023. The Project is expected to be supported by the Market Accelerator for Green Construction (MAGC) Program as described in the Blended Finance Section.
